checks.name: Payment services use fixed response types rather than caller-selected generics
POST /payments body matches backend fields and omits client-supplied currency
Payment quote contract uses backend amount field rather than finalAmount
Payment status and gateway-initialization enums match backend schema values
Gateway verification models approved, processing, pending and failed outcomes
Plan configuration update type exposes only backend-editable fields
Subscription upgrade quote includes actual backend credit and upgrade fields
Public pricing reads shared React Query plan and subscription hooks
Payment checkout uses gateway and manual-payment hooks instead of raw service calls
Admin payment review uses separate typed list, approve and reject hooks
Admin plan and bank configuration share the same typed plan-config query and mutation
Successful payment verification invalidates payment and subscription caches
Payment decisions invalidate payment records, with approvals also refreshing entitlements
Subscription, payment and plan-config query keys are centralized
Endpoint inventory maps all payment and subscription routes to existing hooks
Email verification requirements are reflected in payment endpoint metadata
